charts.title: TOI-4465 b: orbits around TOI-4465
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4465's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4465 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Essack et al. 2025 (2025AJ....170...41E), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ESSACK_ET_AL__2025): P 101.94054 d
